timezone_resolution_context._note: 2026-03-08 is the US spring-forward date. Local clocks in America/New_York jump from 02:00 EST to 03:00 EDT. The vendor emits both timestamps in UTC (explicit Z), so the adapter parses unambiguously. The downstream business-date resolver (iana_timezone_converter.toBusinessDate) projects onto 2026-03-07 if business-day-cutoff is 04:00 local, since 06:55 UTC = 02:55 EST (pre-shift) and 08:30 UTC = 04:30 EDT (post-shift). The fact straddles the spring-forward gap.
